items.item_text: Experience supporting compensation, classification, human resources, labor relations, payroll, or workforce administration functions within a large, complex organization.
Experience with UC Path, Salesforce (Aggie Service), Job Builder, Tableau, OnBase, Cognos reporting or similar/related systems.
40% - Receipt, Tracking and Distribution of Compensation and Classification Actions
20% - Compensation and Classification Systems, Data Management, and Reporting
5% - Requests for Information (RFIs) and Litigation Support
Basic knowledge of classification and compensation principles, practices, policies, procedures, and fundamental human resources concepts.

Knowledge of UC Davis Health Human Resources functions, organizational structure, and key stakeholder relationships, including Compensation Services, Talent Acquisition, Health SSO, Labor Relations, the UC Davis Medical Center, the School of Medicine, and the School of Nursing.
